summary:
**ASTROCARE – Astronaut Health Monitoring and AI Wellness System**

ASTROCARE is a web-based astronaut health monitoring and wellness platform designed to support crew members during space missions. It allows astronauts to record and track important health readings, including pulse rate, blood pressure, glucose levels, body temperature, sleep, stress, and mood. The platform provides health history, visual trend analysis, alerts for readings outside configured thresholds, and daily wellness activities.

ASTROCARE also includes an AI-powered wellness assistant concept to help astronauts understand health information and access general wellness guidance. By connecting the platform with authentic NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) research, ASTROCARE aims to make spaceflight health research more accessible and meaningful.

The project addresses the challenges of monitoring astronaut well-being during long-duration missions, where continuous health awareness and timely support are essential. Its goal is to promote proactive health monitoring, support informed decisions, and contribute to safer and healthier space exploration.
details:
ASTROCARE is a web-based astronaut health monitoring and wellness platform designed to support astronaut well-being during space missions.

The platform allows astronauts to record and monitor health information such as pulse rate, blood pressure, glucose levels, body temperature, sleep, stress, and mood. It provides a health history section where users can view, edit, and delete previous readings. Interactive charts help visualize health trends, while configurable alerts highlight readings that fall outside selected health thresholds. Daily wellness activities encourage astronauts to maintain healthy routines.

ASTROCARE also includes an astronaut profile system, a wellness assistant, and educational features related to spaceflight health. The project aims to make health information easier to track and understand, encouraging proactive health awareness during long-duration missions.

We developed ASTROCARE using React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Supabase for authentication and database management. The project is software-based and does not require additional hardware.

Its creative approach is to combine health tracking, visual analytics, wellness activities, and space-related health education in one platform. We considered usability, data privacy, accessibility, and the challenges of maintaining astronaut health in isolated space environments.

Our intended impact is to support better health awareness, encourage early attention to unusual readings, and contribute to safer and healthier human space exploration.
